args.subject: Inquiry about child seats availability
args.body:
Hello,

I would like to ask whether you offer child seats for your rental cars. Could you please let me know if they are available and, if so, any details regarding pricing and reservation?

Thank you in advance.

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Blue Sparrow Tech
